contract.title: Threat Intelligence Dashboard Visual Unification REWORK 1
acceptance_criteria: Only frontend/src/workspaces/threat-intelligence/pages/ThreatIntelligenceOverviewPage.css and frontend/src/workspaces/threat-intelligence/pages/ThreatIntelligenceOverviewPage.test.tsx may change; no component, product logic, data source, environment page, workspace test, shell, route, backend, provider or reference file may change.
The immutable visual authority remains .ai/references/TASK-0124-product-owner-mockup.png with SHA-256 1ae207282bfa5f23e517f9230cc4ced073d5e1d82e5b862ec38563464cdcee87 and dimensions 1402 x 1122.
The page-local Main inset is 19px left and 17px right with a maximum tolerance of four pixels on each side; a two-pixel horizontal inset is a failing regression.
The snapshot instruments remain in their existing order and follow proportional target widths 199 204 224 224 204 within the active task tolerance with 105px height and approximately 13px gaps.

The snapshot cards and four gaps fit the available snapshot inner width without horizontal overflow or clipping and the implementation does not substitute repeat five equal fractional columns for the measured width contract.
The passed middle row remains approximately 749 to 420 or 1.78 to 1 with an approximately 14px gap; Our Environment remains dominant and Threat Landscape remains narrower.

The bottom row uses geometry independent from the middle row with Intelligence Feeds approximately 573px and Recent Intelligence approximately 594px or 0.965 to 1 with an approximately 16px gap and 411px panel height.
The bottom row does not inherit or reproduce the middle-row 1.78 to 1 split and neither bottom panel overflows or clips.

Deterministic CSS contract tests independently verify the two Main insets, five snapshot width proportions, card height, snapshot gap and fit arithmetic and reject the prior two-pixel and equal-column regressions.

Deterministic CSS contract tests independently preserve the middle-row ratio and gap and verify the bottom-row widths, ratio, gap and height; substituting a 1.78 to 1 bottom split must make the test fail.
The tests state their CSS-contract nature and do not claim native browser pixel measurement; Product Owner browser acceptance remains mandatory.

Relevant Findings remains derived only from the successful real getFindings collection and Active Campaigns, Threat Actors, New IOCs and High Risk CVEs remain truthful number-free not-connected or unavailable states.
The passed real Our Environment implementation, getFindings integration, search fields, finding deep link and loading, error, empty and no-match states remain unchanged.
The passed truthful Threat Landscape, Intelligence Feeds and Recent Intelligence representations remain unchanged with no illustrative entries, values, severities, geography, trends or times.

Canonical Threat Intelligence routes, Back and Forward behavior, URL authority, TASK-0122, TASK-0123, WorkspaceSwitcher, Sidebar, Topbar, Platform shell, API clients, backend and all reference images remain unchanged.
Focused overview geometry and state tests, Threat Intelligence route and deep-link regressions, TASK-0122 and TASK-0123 regressions, shell regressions and full frontend regression pass.
TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass; Scope Guard reports exactly the two authorized files and protected reference hashes remain unchanged.
Architect Implementation Review directly verifies all three numeric corrections and Product Owner Live Acceptance remains required before DONE.
Do not transition TASK-0124 to DONE or create TASK-0125.
